title: Correspondence-Free Camera Pose Estimation by Matching Moments
abstract: arXiv:2611.20797v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The blind perspective-$n$-point (PnP) problem is to estimate the pose of a calibrated camera from 2D and 3D point sets with unknown correspondences. We show that, for complete, noiseless observations, fourteen permutation-invariant image moments up to order four identify a fixed camera pose for almost every 3D point set containing at least twenty points. Our learning-free method, MomentPnP, matches these moments between the observed 2D points and the projected 3D points to initialize a camera pose without correspondences and refines the pose and correspondence weights using expectation--maximization. Across the test sets of three benchmarks, our method reduces median rotation error by $5$--$170\times$ relative to the best learned baseline, both with and without outliers. We recover accurate poses even with as many outliers as inliers. On dense ETH3D scans, pose accuracy improves as the point sets grow, even as individual correspondence

translated_title: 基于矩匹配的无对应关系相机位姿估计
translated_abstract: 盲透视n点（PnP）问题旨在从对应关系未知的二维和三维点集中估计已标定相机的位姿。我们证明，对于完整且无噪声的观测，十四个不超过四阶的置换不变图像矩几乎可以为每个包含至少二十个点的三维点集唯一确定固定的相机位姿。我们的免学习方法MomentPnP在观测到的二维点与投影后的三维点之间匹配这些矩，从而在无对应关系的情况下初始化相机位姿，并使用期望最大化算法细化位姿和对应关系权重。在三个基准测试集上，无论是否存在外点，我们的方法相比最优的学习类基线方法将中位旋转误差降低了5至170倍。即使外点数量与内点数量相当，我们也能恢复出准确的位姿。在密集的ETH3D扫描数据上，随着点集规模的增大，位姿精度持续提升，即使单个对应关系……
tldr: 该论文提出免学习方法MomentPnP，通过匹配置换不变图像矩实现无对应关系的相机位姿初始化，并利用期望最大化细化位姿，在有外点的情况下旋转误差较最优学习类基线降低5至170倍。
en_tdlr: MomentPnP is a learning-free method that estimates camera pose without correspondences by matching permutation-invariant image moments between 2D and 3D point sets and refining via expectation-maximization, reducing median rotation error by 5–170× over the best learned baseline even in the presence of outliers.
